description:
Expressify is an Express.js-inspired Java 17+ web framework for building REST APIs and web
        applications. Powered by embedded Undertow — no servlet container, no annotations, no magic.
        Drop-in middleware pipeline (CORS, Helmet, compression, rate limiting, sessions, static files,
        file uploads), chainable routing with path parameters and wildcards, full req/res API, JSON
        body parsing, and built-in support for Thymeleaf, Pebble, FreeMarker, and JTE template engines.
        Ideal for microservices, REST backends, and lightweight HTTP servers on Java 17+.
